requirements.statement: Define and verify credential isolation, local privilege, remote-content isolation, and signed-update requirements.

proposedVerification.condition: No approved secret flow reaches logs or an unauthorized consumer, and unsigned or tampered updates are rejected.
proposedVerification.method: Threat model review, secret-flow tests, IPC capability tests, and signed-update adversarial tests.
proposedVerification.environment: Supported Windows and macOS targets with production-equivalent packaging keys in a controlled release environment.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Representative account, tool-key, temporary rollback snapshot, crash, log, and update cases; exact matrix pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before every production release and after any credential or updater contract change.

requirements.statement: Define and verify collection, consent, retention, deletion, diagnostic export, and third-party disclosure rules.

proposedVerification.condition: Every collected field has an approved purpose and lifecycle, and diagnostics exclude prompts, project contents, and secrets.
proposedVerification.method: Data-flow inventory, lifecycle review, diagnostic bundle inspection, and consent-state tests.
proposedVerification.environment: Clean and upgraded local profiles on supported Windows and macOS targets.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: All declared data resources and every export, deletion, and consent state; exact fixtures pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before release and whenever telemetry, diagnostics, or credential storage changes.

requirements.statement: Define and verify deterministic configuration transactions, recovery, retries, expiry, and partial-failure behavior.

proposedVerification.condition: No injected write, validation, network, or relaunch failure silently loses pre-existing configuration.
proposedVerification.method: Integration tests with fault injection across temporary-snapshot creation, write, validation, probe, rollback, cleanup, and relaunch boundaries.
proposedVerification.environment: Real filesystem semantics on supported Windows and macOS versions.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Every supported tool, file-state class, and defined failure boundary; exact matrix pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Every release that changes a tool adapter or transaction engine.

requirements.statement: Define and verify privacy-safe operation correlation, local diagnostics, support lookup, and failure classification.

proposedVerification.condition: Every material local operation can be traced without exposing credentials, prompts, or project contents.
proposedVerification.method: Integration tests and structured diagnostic export inspection for successful, partial, failed, and recovered operations.
proposedVerification.environment: Supported Windows and macOS targets with representative network and filesystem failures.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: All operation types and error classes; exact event counts pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before release and after any diagnostic schema change.

requirements.statement: Define and verify startup, scan, page response, price calculation, and configuration-operation responsiveness.

proposedVerification.condition: Measured operations meet product-owner-approved thresholds on the minimum supported devices.
proposedVerification.method: Repeatable cold/warm startup, scan, navigation, and configuration benchmarks.
proposedVerification.environment: Approved minimum and representative Windows and macOS hardware; targets pending.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Representative tool counts, pricing catalog sizes, usage records, and unfinished transaction snapshots; volumes pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before release and after dependency or startup-path changes.

requirements.statement: Define and verify supported local catalog, usage history, log, unfinished-transaction, and concurrent-operation limits.
targetDimensions: unfinished transaction and concurrent operation bounds

proposedVerification.condition: The client remains correct and responsive at approved local data and operation limits.
proposedVerification.method: Load and soak tests with bounded model, usage, unfinished-transaction, and diagnostic datasets.
proposedVerification.environment: Approved minimum Windows and macOS devices; targets pending.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Product-owner-approved maximum catalog, history, log, unfinished-transaction, and operation volumes; currently unknown.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before release and when data-retention or catalog contracts change.

requirements.statement: Define and verify keyboard, screen-reader, scaling, contrast, focus, and plain-language requirements.

proposedVerification.condition: All V1 journeys remain operable with approved assistive technologies and display scaling targets.
proposedVerification.method: Automated accessibility checks plus manual keyboard, screen-reader, scaling, and contrast review.
proposedVerification.environment: Supported Windows and macOS versions with approved assistive technologies.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Every V1 page, required state, dialog, and primary action; exact device matrix pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Every visual release and after navigation or component-library changes.

requirements.statement: Determine whether any V1 recommendation is AI-generated and define deterministic or evaluated quality boundaries accordingly.

proposedVerification.condition: No AI-generated candidate is presented as a verified configuration, diagnosis, compatibility, or price fact.
proposedVerification.method: Architecture inspection and, if AI scenarios exist, scenario evaluation against approved datasets and abstention cases.
proposedVerification.environment: Frozen V1 recommendation and diagnostic paths; AI use decision pending.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: All recommendation and diagnosis scenarios, or an approved not-applicable decision if none use AI.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before activating any AI-generated recommendation or diagnosis.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the bounded cost of connectivity probes and any future AI-assisted client scenario.

proposedVerification.condition: Every billable client-generated request has an approved purpose, bound, attribution, and retry policy.
proposedVerification.method: Contract tests and cost reconciliation against server usage records.
proposedVerification.environment: Test account and production-equivalent pricing rules without modifying production billing.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Every probe, retry, cancellation, and recovery path; numeric budget pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before release and after any probe or AI scenario changes.

requirements.statement: Define and verify price-display accuracy, billing-authority messaging, wallet handoff, and paid-capability boundaries.

proposedVerification.condition: Displayed actual prices reconcile with approved server pricing inputs and wallet links remain first-party.
proposedVerification.method: Pricing contract tests, tier/group fixtures, source-freshness tests, and wallet destination validation.
proposedVerification.environment: Controlled accounts across approved pricing groups and billing modes.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Every supported billing mode, group, cache class, tier, and unavailable-price case; exact matrix pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before release and whenever pricing or wallet routing changes.

requirements.statement: Define and verify client-data, configuration-adapter, and updater compatibility across supported versions.

proposedVerification.condition: Approved previous-version client data migrates safely, and any unfinished configuration transaction is recovered or explicitly blocks migration without corrupting third-party tool configuration.
proposedVerification.method: Migration and downgrade contract tests against immutable version fixtures.
proposedVerification.environment: Supported Windows and macOS upgrade and rollback paths.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Every supported predecessor version and declared schema transition; initial baseline pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Every release containing a schema or adapter contract change.

requirements.statement: Define and verify encrypted transaction-scoped rollback, cleanup, crash recovery, and the prohibition on retained configuration-backup history.

proposedVerification.condition: Every failed or interrupted supported configuration transaction restores the exact prior state without secret disclosure, while every successful transaction leaves no retained snapshot.
proposedVerification.method: Production-like snapshot, corruption, restore, cleanup, crash, relaunch, and version-transition rehearsals.
proposedVerification.environment: Supported Windows and macOS filesystems with real permissions and representative tool configurations.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Every supported tool, file-state class, secret-bearing case, and transaction interruption boundary; exact counts pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before release and after any snapshot format, adapter, cleanup, or recovery change.

requirements.statement: Define and verify release signing, update publication, incident response, rollback, support, and key-custody operations.

proposedVerification.condition: A production-like signed release can be published, updated, rolled back, and investigated under approved access controls.
proposedVerification.method: End-to-end release rehearsal, signature verification, failed-update recovery, key-rotation, and incident tabletop exercises.
proposedVerification.environment: Production-equivalent Windows and macOS signing, notarization, hosting, and updater environments.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Complete release artifact matrix and declared failure scenarios; platform list pending.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Every production release and after any signing, hosting, or updater change.
